based_on: experiment/v3/study.json: the same runner, arms, agent configurations, scenarios and measurements. Only the guidance levels, the per-session budget caps and the seed differ.
placement: end of turn: the experiment Stop hook (arm B), also registered on UserPromptSubmit so the repair budget resets each turn; arm A has no hooks

one-line.label: lean prompt
one-line.description: Byte-identical to version 3's one-line level: the Architecture section is one sentence, 'The code is layered: controllers, application, infrastructure and domain. Keep to the layering.'

handbook.label: large handbook
handbook.description: A generated monorepo-style instruction file of about 160,000 characters (experiment/tools/make_handbook.py): fifteen general sections and templated per-team service rules, with version 2's full Architecture section, verbatim, about 60% of the way down.

instruction_delivery: workspace CLAUDE.md only, loaded by Claude Code with --setting-sources project; not passed with --append-system-prompt-file
prompt_suffix: Work in this repository until the request is complete, then reply with a short summary of what you changed.

sonnet.response_reserve_note: one response at Claude Sonnet 5.5's documented limits and highest rates (run_pilot.py, sources.md T20)

haiku.effort_note: not set: the CLI default is used
haiku.response_reserve_note: one response at Claude Haiku 5.5's documented limits and long-context rates (README, live-judge spend bound)

agent.session: one fresh process per session, --no-session-persistence; steps sent as successive user messages with --input-format stream-json
agent.seed: unsupported by the Claude Code CLI; not set

A.label: instruction only
A.description: The workspace CLAUDE.md for the session's guidance level and the steps. No architecture feedback while working.

B.label: instruction + structural gate
B.description: A plus the deterministic import-contract sensor at the end of each turn, with up to max_repairs repair requests per turn. The diagnostic names the rule and how to fix it.

budget.basis: CLI-reported total_cost_usd (API-equivalent list price; notional under a subscription login)
budget.agent_cap_sum_note: 24 Sonnet sessions x US$1.50 + 24 Haiku sessions x US$0.50, the per-session --max-budget-usd caps (exploratory handbook sessions cost about US$0.60 and US$0.07)
budget.judge_allowance_note: one evaluation judge call per session on the final controllers; no development-time judge (there is no arm C)
budget.enforcement: the shared spend ledger reserves each session's cap plus one maximal response before it starts and refuses any session that would pass the shared US$100 cap; refused sessions are recorded as not_started_cap
